questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Bangladesh : Dhaka :: New Zealand : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second word represents the **capital **of the respective **country**.

Bangladesh : Dhaka → Dhaka is the **capital **city of Bangladesh.

Similarly:

New Zealand : Wellington → Wellington is the **capital **city of New Zealand.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Kohima : Nagaland :: ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First word (Capital city) : second word (State).**

Kohima is capital of Nagaland.

Similarly,

Shillong is capital of Meghalaya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shillong : Meghalaya".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word and the fourth word is related to the third word.

Retina : Eye :: Pons : Brain :: Cochlea : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Retina : Eye → Retina is the layer of photoreceptors cells of nerve tissue at the back eye that receive images.

And,

Pons : Brain → Pons is the part of the central nervous system located at the base of the brain.

Similarly,

Cochlea : ? → Cochlea is a hollow, spiral-shaped bone found the inner ear that play the role in the sens of hearing.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ear".**

questions.question: ‘Frogs’ is related to ‘Croak’ in the same way as ‘Peacock’ is related to ‘______’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

‘Frogs’ is related to ‘Croak’ → A **croak** is the low, hoarse** sound** a **frog** makes.

Similarly, 

Scream → A scream is the high-pitched sound a peacock makes.

Hence, ‘Scream’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Hooghly : Kolkata :: Ganga : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second word is a city on the bank of the river mentioned in the first word.

Here,

Hooghly : Kolkata → Kolkata is a city on the bank of the Hooghly River.

Similarly,

Ganga : ? → Patna is a city on the bank of the Ganga River.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Patna"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Square : Rectangle :: Rhombus : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

Square : Rectangle → The shape of **Square **is most similar to the **Rectangle **Shape.

 
• **Every square is a rectangle.**

Similarly,

Rhombus : Parallelogram → The shape of **Rhombus **is most similar to the **Parallelogram **shape.

 
• **Every rhombus is considered as a parallelogram** but the **converse is always not true.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/ Relation.

Time : Seconds :: ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Concept being measured : Specific unit to measure it

**Given :**

 
• Time : Seconds

**Seconds** is a unit of measurement for **time**. 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Pressure : Litre ⇒Incorrect

Pressure is measured using a unit called pascal and litre is a unit of measurement for volume in the international system of units.

 
• Option - (2) : Newton : Force ⇒Incorrect

Newton is a unit of measurement for force.

 
• Option - (3) : Joule : Work ⇒Incorrect

Joule is a unit of measurement for work.

 
• Option - (4) : Power : Watt ⇒**Correct**

**Watt** is a unit of measurement for **power**.

Hence, **"Option - (4)"** is the correct answer.
